name: M4 recording and audio production - capture, takes, comping, recovery, fades, alignment and stretching
nextAction: RC-A..F verified from existing synthetic/offline suites. RC-G joins the next module release; real interface latency and listening pending.

requirements.name: Audio and MIDI capture with monitoring
requirements.scope: Arm, count-in, record audio input and MIDI, input monitoring, held-take ownership.

requirements.name: Punch and loop takes
requirements.scope: Punch range, loop recording into stacked take lanes.

requirements.name: Take placement and comping
requirements.scope: Place takes, use a take here, flatten unused takes, one Undo per edit.

requirements.name: Take recovery
requirements.scope: Retained/failed takes retry or cancel exactly; nothing recorded is silently lost.

requirements.name: Fades, alignment and consolidation
requirements.scope: Clip fades, first-transient grid alignment, consolidate window and fades.

requirements.name: Time stretching and warping
requirements.scope: Pitch-preserving stretch, tempo warp of recorded audio into new sources.

requirements.name: Exact module release
requirements.scope: Complete suite, module gate and packaged verification before replacing the distribution.

externalAcceptance.name: Recording through the owner's audio interface: latency, monitoring and listening

evidencePolicy: Verified rows need passed receipts binding sources and exact binaries; hardware and listening are separate.
